# Calendar Folder

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

The Calendar (Time) folder is the PKM knowledge space for time-based notes.

**Also known as:** Time Folder

## Scope note

- Includes time clusters: Day, Week, Month, Quarter, Year, Decade, and Life.
